entries.title: I Corinthians 16:1
segments: ¶Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given orders to the churches of Galatia, so you must do also:

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:2
segments: On the first [day] of the week let each one of you lay something aside, storing up as he may prosper, that there be no collections when I come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:3
segments: And when I come, whomever you approve by [your] letters I will send to bear your gift to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:4
segments: But if it is fitting that I go also, they will go with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:5
segments: ¶Now I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia (for I am passing through Macedonia).

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:6
segments: And it may be that I will remain, or even spend the winter with you, that you may send me on my journey, wherever I go.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:7
segments: For I do not wish to see you now on the way; but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:8
segments: But I will tarry in Ephesus until Pentecost.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:9
segments: For a great and effective door has opened to me, and [there are] many adversaries.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:10
segments: ¶Now if Timothy comes, see that he may be with you without fear; for he does the work of the Lord, as I also [do].

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:11
segments: Therefore let no one despise him. But send him on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I am waiting for him with the brethren.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:12
segments: Now concerning [our] brother Apollos, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brethren, but he was quite unwilling to come at this time; however, he will come when he has a convenient time.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:13
segments: ¶Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:14
segments: Let all [that] you [do] be done with love.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:15
segments: I urge you, brethren--you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and [that] they have devoted themselves to the ministry of the saints--

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:16
segments: that you also submit to such, and to everyone who works and labors with [us].

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:17
segments: I am glad about the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, for what was lacking on your part they supplied.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:18
segments: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge such men.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:19
segments: ¶The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you heartily in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:20
segments: All the brethren greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:21
segments: The salutation with my own hand--Paul's.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:22
segments: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. O Lord, come!

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:23
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:24
segments: My love [be] with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
